definition.en: The African Development Bank (AfDB) is a multilateral development finance institution established to contribute to the economic development and social progress of African countries.
definition.hi: The African Development Bank (AfDB) is a multilateral development finance institution established to contribute to the economic development and social progress of African countries.

importanceInUpsc.en: Understanding the AfDB is crucial for UPSC GS-3 as it highlights India's engagement with the Global South and its role in international financial architecture. It provides insights into how India leverages regional development banks to expand its diplomatic and economic footprint in Africa.
